clips.label: Reference 0.01 · control
clips.note: Warm drift persists; the main planet survives and extra small moons develop.
clips.details: Two seconds, 18 paintings, native 1536×1024 and 24 fps. Changes only ref_boost from 1.0 to 0.01. Keeps the image-aware text encoder, edit adapter at strength 1, grounding resolution 768, full scene text plus preservation instruction, CFG1, 0.72→0.615413→0.373081→0 Euler schedule and recorded seed/camera trajectory. Reference and target initialization both use this branch’s already-moved previous painting. No original-opening reference, mask, copyback or refinement. Repeated on the L4 used for both parameter variants; unchanged settings.

clips.label: Reference 0.01 · half adapter
clips.note: Less amber than the control; larger shell holes and broader, rounder spires.
clips.details: Two seconds, 18 paintings, 1536×1024 and 24 fps. Same opening, camera, full material prompt, per-painting seed trajectory and CFG1. Only the already-moved previous painting is the clean reference. New L4 run; archived reference control used RTX PRO 4500.
